notes_for_editor: Sourced: Teton County location, gone status, membership in the Jackson District lookout network, and the district's lack of historic lookouts. Not found: build date, builder, design, staffing, or the date the lookout came down. The HCS PDF is long; only one Cache Creek mention was found in it. The firelookout.com Wyoming index names Cache Creek only in a list of other sites, with no page of its own, so it was not cited.
